text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Golden Generation's secret weapon 
claims victory once more! Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi takes 1st place yet again!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Woooooaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by thunderous cheers, Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi raises her fist.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Proving that it was she, and she alone, 
who defeated every single formidable rival 
vying for the Autumn Shield.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*â âHa, hahaha...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
“—She won today. I will acknowledge that 
fact.”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, tomorrow I will surpass you! The 
me of today won't be here tomorrow!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: (――I feel the heat directed at me.)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
(I'm not just chasing anymore. I'm on the 
side that answers—the passion sent my 
way!!)

—Ah, it gathers. Blazing up. When flames 
gather, they burn even hotter!
Heh... Heheheh. Ahahahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It is deeply regrettable, YES. We were not 
able to stand on that stage.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass suffered another injury, and I need 
time to get my body in top shape.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Then we'll all be together in winter, yes?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: El. Are you, by any chance—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, listen! To the voices of the 
audience! To the voices anticipating 
possibilities!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey! Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi won today, so 
doesn't that make him the strongest of the 
generation after all!?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
No, no, think back! Can anyone really 
surpass El at the Arc?

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Then I'm still gonna believe in Spe! She 
said she's runnin' in the Japan Cup too, 
so I bet she'll do somethin' huge!"

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
The best in Japan— No, the best in the 
world is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who watched us run couldn't stop 
talking excitedly about which of us was 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—In that case, let's hold a fun festival 
that we can only do right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day in November. El Condor Pasa held a 
press conference.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Prix that brings the year to a 
close. —So, you're running in the GⅠ Arima 
Kinen, then?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ah, the Arima!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El-chan did?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
—Are you saying that a world-class 
Umamusume can prove herself to be the 
strongest at home as well?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Trainer! Look at this, look at 
this!!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm watching that news right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa will be running in the 
Arima Kinen. That news spread in the blink 
of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Simultaneously, Umamusume began declaring 
their entry into the Arima Kinen one after 
another.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first ones to throw their hats into 
the ring were Special Week and Grass 
Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems they had originally planned to 
run in the Arima Kinen to close out the 
year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Following right after were Seiun Sky and 
King Halo, who submitted their 
applications too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems they, too, decided they couldn't 
miss this day—a race that will surely 
decide the strongest of their generation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, the Umamusume from the same 
generation as Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi weren't 
the only ones who deemed this opportunity 
impossible to overlook―

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Mejiro Bright and T.M. Opera O, who 
battled fiercely in the Kyoto Daishoten."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Furthermore, this year's Kikuka Sho 
winner, Narita Top Road, has also declared 
her entry for the Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Any Umamusume who can win the 
Arima Kinen against a lineup like this—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—You're an “absolutely” strong Umamusume, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Click!)

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, pardon the intrusion!! 
President, are you in?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ! Tsuyoshi. What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Could you come watch the upcoming Arima 
Kinen too, Madam President?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And right there. To you, the one I've 
looked up to. —There's something I want to 
tell you!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—...And that dream leads toward a 
possibility that might have been.
